shellCommands.command: find . -maxdepth 2 -iname "public" -o -iname "favicon*" | grep -v node_modules; ls -la /workspace; cat /workspace/next-env.d.ts 2>/dev/null; grep -n "next" /workspace/package.json
rm -rf pages styles components/AppProvider.js && git status

rm -rf .next && timeout 25 npx next start -p 3411 & sleep 1; SERVER_PID=$!; echo "waiting for server"; for i in $(seq 1 20); do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3411/ && break; sleep 1; done

npx next start -p 3411 > /tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &
sleep 3
echo "--- / ---"; curl -s http://localhost:3411/ | head -c 600; echo
echo "--- /blog ---"; curl -s http://localhost:3411/blog | head -c 400; echo
echo "--- /blog/1 ---"; curl -s http://localhost:3411/blog/1 | head -c 400; echo
echo "--- /nonexistent (404) ---"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3411/nonexistent
echo "--- /api/posts GET ---"; curl -s http://localhost:3411/api/posts; echo
echo "--- /api/posts/5 GET ---"; curl -s http://localhost:3411/api/posts/5; echo
echo "--- /api/posts POST ---"; curl -s -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"title":"t","content":"c"}' http://localhost:3411/api/posts; echo

curl -s http://localhost:3411/ | grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>'
curl -s http://localhost:3411/blog | grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>'
curl -s http://localhost:3411/blog/1 | grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>'
curl -s http://localhost:3411/ | grep -o 'Welcome to My Blog'
curl -s http://localhost:3411/nonexistent | grep -o '404 - Page Not Found'
kill %1 2>/dev/null; true
